gloss: Make a sudden advance reliable under varied conditions before building on it
mechanism: After a sudden advance, such as a first success, a breakthrough result or a new capability, the advance is repeated under varied conditions, each repetition subject to {{verification}}, until it succeeds reliably. Work that depends on it waits until it has settled.
invariants: The advance is repeated under conditions that differ from the first success.
Work that depends on the advance starts only after the stated reliability is reached.
failure_modes: One-off foundation: work is built on a success that happened once.
Settling forever: the advance is retested long after it is reliable.
